options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: automatic_scan_scheduler
options.description: Schedule for an automatic full Compliance scan.

options.name: enable_email_alerts
options.description: Enables or disables sending email alerts to SmartEvent (only for alerts). The default value is true.

options.name: enable_smart_event_logs
options.description: Enables or disables sending logs to SmartEvent. The default value is true.

options.name: initialize_best_practices
options.description: If true, creates all the default Best Practices again. After the first scan completes, the value of this parameter is automatically set to false. The default value is true for initial setup and false after first scan.

options.name: partial_scan_delay
options.description: Controls when the partial scan starts after publishing a session. The partial scan checks only the relevant firewall best practices. If the value is < 0, the partial scan is disabled. If the value is 0, the partial scan starts immediately after publishing. If the value is > 0, the partial scan is delayed by the specified number of seconds after publishing. The default value is '0'.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
